description: Compose a walk, pack score, draft memo, and derived indicative terms for a named approver. Never records a credit decision, never sends, never wires. Returns walk_pending while a file walk is queued or running. Derived terms are returned with termSheetStaged false unless the file already has a sheet. confirmed true persists principalAmount, rateBps, and termMonths from the arguments; missing numbers write nothing. suggestedOutcome is ready_for_approver, refer, or decline — never approve. Compact-10 APPROVED still needs a staged sheet. A person still decides.

confirmed.description: True only after the named human confirmed the terms. Persist principalAmount, rateBps, and termMonths from these arguments the same way as stage_term_sheet. Unconfirmed prepare never writes a term sheet. Missing numbers → no write.

event.description: Policy event; default origination. Same as score_case_against_pack.

principalAmount.description: Required when confirmed is true. Same as stage_term_sheet.

rateBps.description: Required when confirmed is true. Annual interest in basis points. 625 = 6.25%.

termMonths.description: Required when confirmed is true. Same as stage_term_sheet.

name: prepare_decision
title: Prepare credit decision
